Who we are

Built on experience. Driven by quality.

Since our founding in 2001, originally known as IBN AL BALAD and AL-SEROH AL SHAMIKHA (ASAS), Oasis Fajr has been a trusted name in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's contracting industry. With an unwavering commitment to excellence, we have continuously delivered successful projects that meet high standards of quality.

We continue to evolve with the demands of the industry, keeping our skills and capabilities current. Our work is guided by steady improvement rather than shortcuts, and by delivery that holds up after handover.

Safety & Quality

Safety and quality at every stage

Safety, quality, and reliability guide our work from planning and material approval through site execution, inspection, and final handover.

  • Site safety supervision

    A designated Safety Officer, with supervisors and marshals, is responsible for implementing our HSE policy on site.

  • Material approval and verification

    Materials are submitted, approved and verified against specification before installation begins.

  • Quality inspections

    Work is inspected stage by stage so defects are caught while they are still inexpensive to correct.

  • Progress monitoring

    Programme, manpower and completed scope are tracked and reported against the agreed schedule.

  • Project documentation

    Job safety analyses, inspection records and site instructions are documented throughout the project.

  • Final testing and handover

    Systems are tested and commissioned, then handed over with the supporting records.
